items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I was in the army with Irving Ashby, and we were in the same outfit

ctx.x: I think I always taught. You know, the guitar players just seem to gravitate towards me for some unknown reason, and I started right in teaching, you know. It's like turning a switch, and then I started in. But any way, speaking of teaching I did -- I was in the army with Irving Ashby, and we were in the same outfit, and I would sit up and play for him all day long and show him different chord structures, different melodies and things. And --
